evals.name: implement
evals.prompt: Theme a Components button inside one part of the host. Give the component boundary and a check for the resulting interaction.
evals.expected_output: Load the published token and component styles in the application stylesheet. Override a documented token on the smallest host element that contains the themed controls.
assertions: Identify the renderer and the published rules for the target part. Done: an outline Button uses the primary color token after baseline styles load.
Import @cratis/components/tokens then @cratis/components/styles in host.css. Set --cratis-primary-color to rgb(101, 29, 155) only on .accent. Done: computed color changes on Preview but not Outside.
Load the published token and component styles in the application stylesheet. Override a documented token on the smallest host element that contains the themed controls.

evals.name: diagnose
evals.prompt: My token changes but the actual outline button does not. Give the component boundary and a check for the resulting interaction.
evals.expected_output: If the token changes but the rendered color does not, inspect the active renderer and the part consuming the token. Do not override a private descendant selector to force a match.
assertions: If the token changes but the rendered color does not, inspect the active renderer and the part consuming the token. Do not override a private descendant selector to force a match.
Import @cratis/components/tokens then @cratis/components/styles in host.css. Set --cratis-primary-color to rgb(101, 29, 155) only on .accent. Done: computed color changes on Preview but not Outside.
Navigate with the keyboard in the browser, not a DOM emulator. Done: the scoped outline button changes color, its sibling stays unchanged, and keyboard focus has a visible ring or outline.
